What if you could re-light an entire video with a single click — no reshoots, no 3D models, just AI?I just tested NVIDIA AI’s Cosmos DiffusionRenderer locally on my machine, and the results blew me away.If you already have Cosmos Predict 1 installed, it takes just a couple of minutes to get up and running — and only minutes per video to process.Here’s what I show in the demo:Screen 1 → The source video + extracted geometry maps (normals, depth, base color).Screen 2 → The same video, but re-lit under three completely different lighting conditions.It’s all running on a single workstation. But you only need 16GB of VRAM.👉 Here’s my question:When this becomes real-time, what industry do you think will feel the biggest disruption first? Film, gaming, or something else entirely?Erik Weaver Todd Terrazas Conrad Curtishashtag#AI hashtag#GENAI hashtag#VFX hashtag#Computervision

Here is an explanation of the technique behind the video I made in my first year.I used 5 images and switched between their opacity to create the effect.The opacity was parented to the Audio Amplitude.Code:```AdobeAfterEffectsExpression// Reference to the first image (same code for each image but with different input and output highs and lows)audioLayer = thisComp.layer("Audio Amplitude");audioData = audioLayer.effect("Both Channels")("Slider");inputLow = 35;inputHigh = 45;outputLow = 0;outputHigh = 100;mappedValue = linear(audioData, inputLow, inputHigh, outputLow, outputHigh);mappedValue;```The same code is used for each image with different input and output high and low values.hashtag#AfterEffects hashtag#VideoEditing hashtag#MotionGraphics hashtag#AudioVisualization hashtag#DigitalArt hashtag#CreativeProcess hashtag#Animation hashtag#VideoProduction hashtag#AdobeAfterEffects hashtag#VisualEffects hashtag#BoyHostelLife hashtag#StudentProject hashtag#CreativeEditing hashtag#MediaProduction hashtag#VisualArt hashtag#DynamicContent

💥Just wrapped up an exciting project experimenting with cutting-edge NeRF (Neural Radiance Field) AI technology! 📸🖥️Stack: NeRFStudio +      ZipNeRFThroughout this journey, I delved into various tools and techniques:- InstantNGP: For rapid NeRF training and rendering.- NeRFStudio:  is an open-source framework for NeRFs- Nerfacto and ZipNeRF: Tested these algorithms to enhance the efficiency and quality of 3D scene captures.- Photogrammetry: Combined traditional methods with NeRF to create highly detailed models.- SMERF: Worked with Google’s latest 3D capturing algorithm to push the boundaries of what's possible.Check out the video render to see the results of these experiments in action! ✨📹 hashtag#AI hashtag#NeRF hashtag#3DModeling hashtag#TechInnovation hashtag#MachineLearning
